{"response":{"responseId":"z4SPab3kFJm9qtsPp-u44Q4","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":1262,"promptTokenCount":5968,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5968}],"thoughtsTokenCount":11006,"totalTokenCount":18236},"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nvoid restart_mab(kissat *solver) {\n    // Static state to track global progress and stagnation across restart phases.\n    // These emulate the global fields requested (best_lbd, best_assigned_trail)\n    // without modifying the solver structure.\n    static unsigned global_best_assigned = 0;\n    static double global_best_lbd = 1e150;\n    static unsigned consecutive_stagnation = 0;\n    static unsigned last_heuristic = 0;\n\n    // Reset static state if this is the first restart of a run.\n    // GET(restarts) is incremented in kissat_restart before this function is called.\n    if (GET(restarts) \u003c= 1) {\n        global_best_assigned = 0;\n        global_best_lbd = 1e150;\n        consecutive_stagnation = 0;\n        last_heuristic = solver-\u003eheuristic;\n    }\n\n    // --- Step 1: Calculate the raw phase efficiency metric P ---\n    // P = log2(1 + conflicts) / average_LBD\n    \n    double conflicts = (double)solver-\u003emab_conflicts;\n    \n    // Use the fast exponential moving average of glue (LBD) as the phase metric.\n    double avg_lbd = AVERAGE(fast_glue);\n    \n    // Protect against division by zero\n    if (avg_lbd \u003c 0.0001) avg_lbd = 0.0001;\n\n    double P = log2(1.0 + conflicts) / avg_lbd;\n\n    // --- Step 2: Calculate Global Progress Weight W ---\n    // Check if we improved global best assigned variables or best LBD\n    \n    unsigned current_assigned = solver-\u003evars - solver-\u003eunassigned;\n    double current_lbd_metric = avg_lbd; // Lower is better\n    \n    bool progress = false;\n    \n    if (current_assigned \u003e global_best_assigned) {\n        global_best_assigned = current_assigned;\n        progress = true;\n    }\n    \n    if (current_lbd_metric \u003c global_best_lbd) {\n        global_best_lbd = current_lbd_metric;\n        progress = true;\n    }\n    \n    // W = 1.5 if global records broken, 0.8 otherwise\n    double W = progress ? 1.5 : 0.8;\n\n    // --- Step 3: Update the score using a Dynamic Learning Rate ---\n    // alpha = 0.6 if progress, 0.2 otherwise\n    double alpha = progress ? 0.6 : 0.2;\n    unsigned h = solver-\u003eheuristic;\n    \n    // Update Score (EMA)\n    // We reuse solver-\u003emab_reward to store the EMA score.\n    // If this heuristic hasn't been selected before, initialize it.\n    if (solver-\u003emab_select[h] == 0) {\n        solver-\u003emab_reward[h] = P * W;\n    } else {\n        // Score = (1 - alpha) * Score + alpha * (P * W)\n        solver-\u003emab_reward[h] = (1.0 - alpha) * solver-\u003emab_reward[h] + alpha * (P * W);\n    }\n\n    // --- Step 4: Determine next mode with Stagnation Override ---\n    \n    // Update stagnation counter\n    if (h == last_heuristic) {\n        if (!progress) {\n            consecutive_stagnation++;\n        } else {\n            consecutive_stagnation = 0;\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Mode changed (either voluntarily or forced), reset stagnation logic\n        last_heuristic = h;\n        consecutive_stagnation = progress ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n    \n    unsigned next_heuristic = h;\n    \n    // Stagnation Override:\n    // If selected for 10 consecutive intervals without Global Progress (W=1.5), force switch.\n    if (consecutive_stagnation \u003e= 10) {\n        next_heuristic = 1 - h; // Switch to opposite mode (assuming 0 and 1)\n        \n        // Reset stagnation state for the new mode\n        consecutive_stagnation = 0;\n        last_heuristic = next_heuristic;\n    } else {\n        // Determine next mode by comparing scores (Greedy selection)\n        // Ensure both heuristics are initialized at least once\n        if (solver-\u003emab_select[0] == 0) {\n            next_heuristic = 0;\n        } else if (solver-\u003emab_select[1] == 0) {\n            next_heuristic = 1;\n        } else {\n            if (solver-\u003emab_reward[0] \u003e= solver-\u003emab_reward[1]) {\n                next_heuristic = 0;\n            } else {\n                next_heuristic = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Apply selection\n    solver-\u003eheuristic = next_heuristic;\n    solver-\u003emab_select[next_heuristic]++;\n\n    // Reset MAB tracking variables for the next phase\n    for (all_variables(idx)) {\n        solver-\u003emab_chosen[idx] = 0;\n    }\n    solver-\u003emab_chosen_tot = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_decisions = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_conflicts = 0;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]},"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP"}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
